description: This file defines functions and types for managing draft stream controls, including lifecycle management, message ID handling, and stream control operations in a draft messaging system.

methods.name: createFinalizableDraftStreamControls
methods.description: Creates control functions for managing a draft stream, including update, stop, and stopForClear operations.

methods.name: createFinalizableDraftStreamControlsForState
methods.description: Creates draft stream controls based on a given state object.

methods.name: takeMessageIdAfterStop
methods.description: Stops the message process and retrieves the message ID after stopping.

methods.name: clearFinalizableDraftMessage
methods.description: Clears a draft message after stopping, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: createFinalizableDraftLifecycle
methods.description: Creates a lifecycle object for managing draft message controls and clearing.
